title: Hugo and Bloom's Farm Surprise
markdown:
The sun painted the sky with morning light. Hugo, the toy fixer, walked with Bloom the bee. Hugo carried a little wooden robin with a droopy wing.

They came to Farmer McGregor’s farm, full of new life. Tiny chicks, like fluffy yellow seeds, cheeped. Ducklings bobbed beside their mother, their webbed feet ready for paddling. Woolly lambs stood tall on sturdy legs, their horns not yet grown.

Bloom zipped, her antennae curious. "Oh, Hugo!" she hummed. "Why do the ducklings and lambs look like their mamas already? The chicks are just soft puffs!"

Hugo knelt by clover, his voice calm. "Ah, Bloom," he said kindly. "Some babies, like chicks, are born needing parents to keep them warm and help them grow slowly. They need lots of care."

Bloom imagined the chicks snuggled with Mama Hen.

"But then," Hugo smiled, "babies like ducklings and lambs already show what they will become. Their feet for swimming, or their woolly coats, are already there. They are ready to explore, though they will still grow bigger."

Bloom’s wings fluttered. A bee-smile spread. She watched a piglet nuzzle its Mama. "So," she buzzed, understanding dawning, "that piggy already has its snout for snuffling and its oinky sounds, ready to be a big pig like Mama!" She saw a wobbly calf. "And that calf already has its strong legs, ready to grow into a great big cow!" The farm, she realised, was full of wonderful differences.

As the sun began to set, Hugo and Bloom journeyed home. The little robin was safe in Hugo's pocket, its wing strong. Bloom hummed happily. She told a ladybug resting on a grass blade. "Some babies need parents to grow bit by bit," she explained, full of knowing. "And some babies are already ready to discover the world, with their special feet or warm coats! It's a lovely secret!"

Nearing Hugo’s garden, Bloom felt happy curiosity bubble. "Whoooo could have guessed such wonderful ways?" she buzzed, full of awe. "I wonder what other secrets the world is holding!"
characters: Hugo the toy fixer, Bloom the bee, Miss Maple
